# The Steak House on The Verandah
> Historic Devon House, 26 Hope Road, Kingston 10, Jamaica | (876) 616-8831 | reservations@steakhouseja.com | https://steak-house-verandah.vercel.app

## Overview
The Steak House on The Verandah is Kingston, Jamaica's landmark chophouse, nestled on the colonial verandah of George Stiebel's 1881 Devon House estate. Known for prime steaks served with classic, chimichurri, or Jamaican country-style scotch bonnet rubs, the famous broiled "Meat Butter" bone marrow, Norma Shirley legacy stuffed crab backs, local lobster in callaloo thermidor, and estate craft rum cocktails.

## Key Information
- Location: Devon House, 26 Hope Road, Kingston 10, Jamaica
- Coordinates: 18.0148763, -76.7898652
- Phone: +1 (876) 616-8831 | Secondary: +1 (876) 403-6249
- Cuisine: Chophouse, Prime Steaks, Jamaican Fusion, Caribbean Seafood, Craft Rum Bar
- Operating Hours:
  - Tuesday – Saturday: 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM (Lunch, Dinner, Bar)
  - Sunday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  - Monday: Closed for private cellar curation
- Pricing Currency: Jamaican Dollars (JMD). Prices attract 15% GCT & 10% service charge.
